plugin.note: Dawn is the airborne twin - immune to non-halberd melee; hit her with Ranged (Magic resisted more). Carry a rock/granite hammer to finish.

requirements: Access to Grotesque Guardians Dawn's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.
mechanics: Dawn is the airborne twin - immune to non-halberd melee; hit her with Ranged (Magic resisted more). Carry a rock/granite hammer to finish.
Treat this as a boss-specific method: positioning, prayer swaps, phase handling, and death-risk setup should come from the linked source strategy.
Use listed secondary weapons only where their combat style or phase role is relevant.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Dawn is the airborne twin - immune to non-halberd melee; hit her with Ranged (Magic resisted more). Carry a rock/granite hammer to finish.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Dawn is the airborne twin - immune to non-halberd melee; hit her with Ranged (Magic resisted more). Carry a rock/granite hammer to finish.
Use ranged, magic, or a halberd against Dawn because non-halberd melee cannot hit her.

methods.label: Phase 1 Dawn ranged
methods.summary: Attack Dawn first with ranged, magic, or a halberd while Dusk is invulnerable.
prayers: Protect from Melee as a lower-effort alternative near Dawn
steps: Start the fight by attacking Dawn; Dusk is immune during phase one.
Use ranged as the default because Dawn is airborne and resists magic more.
Stack Dawn and Dusk where possible so a charged Venator bow can ricochet into Dawn twice.
Move away from the Stone Ball 3x3 area to avoid being encased.
Push Dawn to 55% health to start phase two.
risks: Stone Ball can stun the player in place if not dodged.
notes: A noxious halberd or crystal halberd can hit Dawn when using a melee-only approach.

methods.label: Phase 3 lightning and orbs
methods.summary: Avoid the lightning attack, intercept or skip Dawn's healing orbs, then finish her with ranged pressure.
prayers: Protect from Melee during the post-lightning prayer sequence
steps: After Dusk reaches 55% health, move away from the lightning zones and avoid standing on or adjacent to charged tiles.
Resume attacking Dawn once she becomes vulnerable.
Absorb or skip the three energy spheres before they heal Dawn.
Use high ranged damage to kill Dawn before orb healing where stats and gear allow.
Use a rock hammer, granite hammer, or Gargoyle smasher unlock when Dawn is under 10 hitpoints.
risks: Lightning deals repeated damage every tick on unsafe tiles.
Missed orbs heal Dawn and lengthen the fight.
notes: High ranged or melee stats can enable an orb skip.
Positioning next to Dawn can let Dusk approach for Venator bow ricochet damage.

methods.label: Hammer finish
methods.summary: Finish Dawn with a rock hammer, granite hammer, rock thrownhammer, or Gargoyle smasher when she falls below 10 hitpoints.
steps: Keep a finisher available throughout the fight.
Use the hammer item on Dawn when she is below 10 hitpoints unless Gargoyle smasher is unlocked.
Prepare for Dusk to absorb Dawn's essence and begin the final phase.
notes: Grotesque Guardians retain the gargoyle hammer-finisher requirement.
A granite hammer can also be part of the melee weapon setup.

body:
# Grotesque Guardians - Dawn

Dawn is the airborne twin - immune to non-halberd melee; hit her with Ranged (Magic resisted more). Carry a rock/granite hammer to finish.
